title: An Investigation of Model Coherence: Narrow Finetunes Contradict Themselves Under Resampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.12129v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A large body of research measures model coherence based on output variance without adequately considering competing causes. We identify two such causes, ambiguity and indifference, and we introduce a set of 175 questions where contradicting answers cannot easily be explained by either. We then measure incoherence in terms of contradictions when resampling answers to the same question. In contrast to other methods our metric has high specificity, and only ranks models as incoherent when the issues are glaring. Even so, we find narrow finetunes score poorly. Inspecting inconsistencies flagged by our method, we find that model organisms from the literature display severe issues such as identity conflation, introspection failures and rationalizations. These findings suggest that the pathologies induced by narrow finetuning may limit what these models can tell us about coherent misaligned behaviour.

translated_title: 模型一致性研究：窄域微调模型在重采样下自相矛盾
translated_abstract: 大量研究基于输出方差来衡量模型一致性，却没有充分考虑其他竞争性原因。我们识别出两种这样的原因——歧义性和无差别性，并引入了一组共175个问题，对于这些问题，相互矛盾的答案很难用上述任一原因来解释。随后，我们通过在重采样同一问题答案时出现的矛盾来衡量模型的不一致性。与其他方法相比，我们的指标具有高特异性，只有在问题非常明显时才会将模型判定为不一致。即便如此，我们发现窄域微调模型的得分仍然很差。通过检查我们方法所标记出的不一致之处，我们发现文献中的模型有机体表现出严重的问题，例如身份混淆、内省失败和事后合理化。这些发现表明，窄域微调所诱发的病理现象可能会限制这些模型在揭示连贯失准（未对齐）行为方面的价值。
tldr: 本研究提出一种高特异性的模型一致性衡量方法，通过175个可排除歧义性和无差别性干扰的问题，发现窄域微调模型在重采样同一问题时存在严重自相矛盾，表现为身份混淆、内省失败等病理现象，这可能限制此类模型在研究连贯失准行为中的参考价值。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a highly specific coherence metric based on 175 questions that rule out ambiguity and indifference, revealing that narrow finetunes severely contradict themselves under resampling—showing pathologies like identity conflation and introspection failures—which may limit their value for studying coherent misaligned behavior.
